mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN status = '已生效' THEN 1 END) AS enableRuleCount, IFNULL(SUM(off_order_count), 0) AS totalOffOrderCount FROM offtime_rule WHERE deleted = 0
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') AS date, IFNULL(SUM(off_order_count), 0) AS orderCount FROM offtime_rule WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY date ASC
